title: 3 Things You Should Never Automate First
description:
Full video linked on this Short.Don't start with money going out. Don't start with anything that emails your customers, because at some point it will email the wrong one. And don't start with a six step chain, because when it breaks you won't know which step did it.

Two steps, three at most. Learn where the sharp edges are on something internal first.

#AIAutomation #AutomationTips #AutomationDNA

top_comments.text:
Your first automation will break. Not might, will. So pick something where breaking means a spreadsheet row in the wrong place, not a client who didn't get invoiced.
The full video linked on this Short covers what to automate instead. Subscribe for AI explained properly, no hype.
